restrictions: This entry uses the exact two-round BLAKE3 55/63-byte non-root last-chunk half-collision construction from proof.md. The type-conditioned test-(2) DFA enforces f9 xor f10 = 1 and f24 xor f25 = 1 xor t, t = (Y4 bit4 xor Y4 bit5), with the two exact lists selected from the member type. No Y9 seven-bit prefilter or H_HIT premise is used.

The member class has 262144 members of each type. Exact E-word counts are 23820160 and 34028800 and each type has 4160 live low-half states; the online source builds both tables and checks these identities. Messages are distinct and the four fixed digest words are checked by the inherited construction.

The exact integer ledger, all budgets, the power certificate, memory and the success premises are in the first section of proof.md. N=87167447489133596522 and log2(N/430)=57.49223041723950, rounded up to 57.4923. Against the base entry the pass row uses the executed share 14110208/2^32 and the word test is three units; MU=0.004425 is re-declared from a preregistered run of 2^38 steps (mean plus six standard errors).

heuristics.statement: The inherited listed-good-trial rate and context-level dependence premise of the fa97a08f construction, unchanged by the typed-list filtering and by every change of this entry.
heuristics.scope: The same 55/63-byte, flags-3, non-root counter walk and exact solver construction, with the same run length and expected count 0.49594.
heuristics.extrapolation: The rate and dependence are inherited; typed lists only remove impossible words pointwise, and no change of this entry alters which trials are searched.
heuristics.limitations: This remains a heuristic premise, not a theorem.

heuristics.statement: The E-lane and pass counts of the walk are at most 1.000051 and 1.001440 times their exact shares, E_COUNT/2^32 per step and PASS_COUNT*E_COUNT/2^64 per step with PASS_COUNT = 14110208, the number of words per 2^32 that the executed test (1) passes (the plain share, not the paired count 8778240 of the base entry), plus a Hoeffding reserve over contexts.
heuristics.scope: All RUN_STEPS outer steps. The preregistered run of 2^38 steps measured 0.9959 of the E share, 0.9955 of the plain pass share and 0.9955 of the live-block model share.
heuristics.extrapolation: The typed counts are exhaustive; the transfer of the sampler law to the run is inherited. The measured ratios are below the declared factors.

heuristics.statement: The mean metered debit of the declared program per outer step (the screen's 64 + 20|T| plus the lane's 15 call-only units plus the executed solver ledger) is at most MU = 0.004425 machine units. MU is the measured mean of the preregistered run (2^38 uniform walk steps, all 2^19 contexts of fixed seeds, mean 0.0043521, standard error 1.21e-05) plus six standard errors, rounded up to four significant digits; the credit adds a Bernstein reserve and a preflight reserve.
heuristics.scope: The unchanged screen and capped solver on the typed-list walk, over the 2^69.862 outer steps of the run.
heuristics.extrapolation: From 2^38 sampled steps (about 2^-31.9 of the run) to the run. The rule (mean plus six standard errors) was written before the run and the whole sample was used. No MU scaling and no H_HIT premise.
heuristics.limitations: The debit has a heavy tail (solver calls are rare, one call can debit up to 23151 units), the standard error is a statistical margin and not a proof, the seeds are pseudorandom, and the true mean is not proved. The Bernstein reserve bounds the run total given the mean, not the mean.

heuristics.extrapolation: Typed lists have the same 4160 live low-half count in either type; the preregistered run measured 1.0110 live blocks per context against the model's 1.0156.
